response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, o.avg_modelconf AS overall_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE o.avg_modelconf IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_modelconf > o.avg_modelconf), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by, q.avg_modelconf / m.mean_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_avg <> 0
